meta.storyTitle: test fixtures and assertions inside the two named test files plus the probe helper edit

summary.prose: Revision 2 addressing design-review feedback. Test-side-only fix of two vscode-plugin test defects, no product code changes. (1) docs-review-panel t3 compile probe: the recorded failing diagnostics are exclusively node_modules .d.ts declaration-file errors (TS2416/TS2503/TS2304/TS2552/TS1203), so the single correct compiler option is skipLibCheck — explicit "types" would not suppress them. compileProbe (scripts/test-harness/probe.mjs:8-25) gains a narrow per-probe skipLibCheck?: boolean option, default off (all other callers unchanged; timeout/compiler-error/interrupted/cleanup behavior untouched), and the panel call site typecheckAgainstPanel (docs-review-panel.test.ts:2497) passes skipLibCheck: true. Distinct controls preserved: the valid real-module fixture must pass (control.ok===true), invalid fixtures must assert the specific diagnostics (/Property .* does not exist on type/ per absent-state member; /not assignable to type .never./ for the unhandled-kind witness) — not merely ok===false — and the shipped-source witness check stays; because shared probe.mjs changes, its own tests (scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts) also run. (2) commands.test.ts:132-143: update ONLY the install tuple of the full-sequence argv assertion to ["/bin/bash", installer, "-y", "--target", root], preserving the start/stop/restart/update tuples (controller.ts:68-76). Runnable selectors: npm test -- --suite=vscode src/chat/__tests__/docs-review-panel.test.ts src/daemon/__tests__/commands.test.ts.

alternativesConsidered.name: Per-probe skipLibCheck option on shared compileProbe
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add skipLibCheck?: boolean (default false) to compileProbe; pass --skipLibCheck only when set; enable it at the docs-review-panel call site only.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Extend compileProbe({root,target,snippet,compiler,budgetMs,skipLibCheck}) in scripts/test-harness/probe.mjs:8-25 so the tsc argv gains --skipLibCheck only when the option is true; typecheckAgainstPanel (docs-review-panel.test.ts:2497) passes skipLibCheck: true; all other callers unchanged (default off). Timeout, compiler-error, interrupted and cleanup-unconfirmed behavior untouched. Separately update commands.test.ts:132-143 install tuple only.
pros: Targets exactly the recorded failure class: every failing diagnostic is a node_modules .d.ts declaration error (TS2416/TS2503/TS2304/TS2552/TS1203); skipLibCheck skips declaration-file checking while leaving TS source and fixture diagnostics fully active
Smallest change that fully meets the Story; no new abstraction; default-off preserves every other caller
Probe semantics stay "did tsc accept this fixture against the real module" — the negative fixtures still fail on real type errors
cons: Touches the shared harness probe, so its own tests (scripts/__tests__/test-harness.test.ts) must also run

alternativesConsidered.name: Per-probe explicit types option
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add types?: string[] to compileProbe and pass --types when set.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Pass --types to tsc to restrict ambient @types inclusion.
cons: Does NOT suppress diagnostics from imported declaration files — the failing errors come from imported node_modules .d.ts, which --types does not cover; would not fix not-ok-78

alternativesConsidered.name: Post-filter probe output to project paths
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Keep tsc broad; classify diagnostics and fail only on errors in fixture/panel sources.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Parse compileProbe output and ignore errors whose path is under node_modules.
cons: Reimplements scoping in the caller; fragile path parsing; leaves the probe broad for every caller; weaker than skipLibCheck because it filters after the fact and can miss/overmatch paths
